Stress Management at 
the Workplace
Anirban Mukherjee, RGIPT

Definition
• Is a dynamic condition in which an individual is
confronted with an opportunity, demand or resource
related to what the individual desires and for which the
outcome is perceived to be both uncertain and
important.
• Is all stress bad?

Sources of Stress
• Environmental Factors
• Organizational Factors
• Personal Factors

Organizational 
Factors
Pressures to avoid errors or complete 
tasks in a limited time, Work Overload, 
A demanding and Insensitive boss, 
Unpleasant Coworkers.
